discovery.area: B1 national (US federal, EU, UK, China, Korea, Japan) and B2 US states — light weekly pass, group B
discovery.summary: Chased the four assigned questions. (1) No DOJ AI Litigation Task Force suit against SB 53, RAISE or Illinois found; DOJ's only announced action remains intervention in xAI v. Weiser (Colorado). (2) The xAI v. Weiser docket shows the Apr 27, 2026 minute order staying AG enforcement of SB 24-205 or its replacement until 14 days after a preliminary-injunction ruling; no later ruling (used in co-timing). (3) No official copy of the Commerce Sec. 4 evaluation found. (4) Late-September federal and state developments not on the map: a White House-hosted industry accord on frontier AI (29 Sep 2026, secondary sources only), the Florida AG's request to bar OpenAI from training new models, federal superintelligence bills, and a March 2026 'National Super Intelligence Policy Framework' mentioned by the White House. Japan AI Basic Plan re-verified and drafted as an addition. Korea: nothing new found beyond the grace-period wording.

candidates.name: White House Accord on Super Intelligence: Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities (29 Sep 2026; Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, Nvidia)
candidates.reason: Reported commitments to internal controls, oversight teams, independent external auditors and an independent review committee; would be a significant L5 (or L2) cross-firm commitment on the Seoul-commitments model. No primary text found: the White House fact sheet of the same day mentions only EO 14434, and no whitehouse.gov URL for the accord exists in its sitemaps. High priority for the next run (try company newsrooms or Truth Social copy).

discovery.area: B4 Labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI): new or revised frontier safety / compliance frameworks since 1 Oct 2026
discovery.summary: One new framework version: Meta v2.1 (2 Oct 2026, retitled Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework), with a Meta post announcing a Board AI committee. No new Anthropic RSP version (v3.4 current; policy page last updated 14 Aug 2026 with the August Risk Report), no new FSF version (v3.1), no new xAI edition (x.ai/safety still links the 30 Jun 2026 FAIF; site now branded SpaceXSI after the SpaceX acquisition), and no OpenAI Preparedness v3 found (search only; openai.com blocks automated clients). Meta's post says its update reflects 'commitments made at the White House this week'; secondary sources describe a White House accord of 29 Sep 2026 signed by six firms, but no primary text was found. The FAQ on lab frameworks was confirmed stale and a correction drafted.

candidates.reason: Potentially significant L5 cross-firm commitment (internal controls, internal verification team, external auditor/evaluator, board committee).
